claims.statement: For N spin-1/2 particles in rho_N,0 = Z^{-1} exp(2 J^2/N), every closed-system unitary generated by an arbitrary time-dependent permutation-invariant Hamiltonian leaves rho_N,0 exactly unchanged for all time.
assumptions: J = sum_i sigma_i/2 and J^2 = J_x^2 + J_y^2 + J_z^2
The input is exactly the isotropic critical Gibbs state rho_N,0
At every time H_c(t) commutes with every site permutation
The dynamics is closed-system unitary; no bath, measurement-conditioned branch, reset, or symmetry-breaking term
claims.status: internally reconstructed exact finite-N theorem under explicit assumptions
claims.novelty_boundary: Schur-Weyl commutant and Casimir invariance are standard; no priority claim. The model-specific control no-go still needs exact-contract prior-art search.

costs.runtime: unrestricted; conclusion holds at every time
costs.control_energy: unrestricted amplitude and arbitrary symmetric many-body terms
costs.work: for cyclic pulses, the state and endpoint energy under H_N are unchanged; peak control hardware cost is not modeled
costs.data: no identification data; exact model and Gibbs preparation are supplied

claims.falsifier: Under a verified rho_N,0 input and a pulse verified to commute with all site permutations, any measured collective outcome distribution changes beyond statistical and apparatus error.
claims.next_gate: Specify a bath/reset, measurement, or symmetry-breaking controller and charge work, duration, success probability, and input acquisition.

claims.statement: For target rho_N,b proportional to exp(2 J^2/N + b J_z/N^(3/4)), b>0, every admissible control output has trace distance at least eta_N(b)/2 from target, where eta_N(b) = Tr[sgn(J_z) rho_N,b]. Conditional on Astra N20's quartic-vector limit, eta_N(b) converges to eta(b)>0, yielding a nonzero limiting error floor eta(b)/2.
assumptions: The target is the critical Gibbs family member with fixed dimensionless b>0
N20 quartic-vector convergence applies to this target and the sign statistic; the limit law has no mass on x_z=0
claims.status: exact finite-N inequality; asymptotic constant conditional on source-derived, externally unreviewed N20 limit
claims.novelty_boundary: The sign-separation calculation is derived from the N20 quartic law; no external proof or priority check has been completed.

costs.sample_complexity: O(epsilon^-2) independent critical-state preparations to estimate the sign mean to additive epsilon at fixed confidence
costs.target_acquisition: preparation cost of a b-tilted equilibrium reference is not modeled

claims.falsifier: For an admitted fixed b>0, a valid N20-limit reconstruction yielding eta(b)<=0 or finite-N eta_N(b) failing to converge to the positive integral would refute the claimed asymptotic gap.
claims.next_gate: Independently reconstruct the finite-N to quartic sign-statistic convergence from the spin-sector partition weights and test an admitted b against a finite-N sequence.

numerics.method: mpmath quadrature at 40 decimal digits; decimals are not certified intervals
